character.name: Vex Marrowlight
character.appear: Wiry, quick-eyed, ink-stained fingers; a grey hood over dark braids.
character.backstory: A copyist's apprentice who learned that the right whisper opens more doors than any key.

abilities.ds: Double damage dice when unseen or flanking.
On a failed DEX save, take half damage instead of full.
Open locks and bypass traps with a DEX check.
Illusion and enchantment spells. Mage Hand for theft. Distract and confuse.

questLog.title: What the Blighted Carry
questLog.desc: Travel into the outer Reach to find displaced Northlander settlements and confirm the dispossessions are real and already in motion

Serevka Dross.firstEncounter:
You keep walking. Don't stop. Don't look directly at her.

The spell comes easy, a thread of will, barely a thought. You aim it across the gap.

*"You have the wrong person."*

Her lips don't move.

Jareth Mordrath.firstEncounter:
You don't wait for her to lead you. You walk ahead.

The Greywarden is low-ceilinged and close. Smoke from a peat fire sits at head height. The smell is wet wool, cheap tallow, something fermented that didn't quite finish. Four tables. A bar that is just planks over barrels.

Mordvik.firstEncounter:
You pull back across the road. There's a hay storage overhang above a stable, dark, recessed, with clean sightlines to the cartwright's front and the corner of the back wall.

You get up there without a sound. Settle in. Wait.

Twenty minutes. Cold working into your back.
